title: fix(metadata)!: a version the platform registered is never restored into a package's row, and adopt-orphans leaves the platform's record
body:
Fixes #37604

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/` page teaches restoring a platform-registered version, adopting orphans over the platform's record, or `listPackageBindings`

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:平台撤回某个内置记录后,管理员按包回滚(或回退某个包的提交)时,如果选中的是平台自己登记的那个版本,会被明确拒绝并提示改为重新保存;"领养孤儿元数据"不再把平台内置记录划进某个包;其余操作不变。
- 为什么做:这是平台内置技能、智能体、工具那一轮收尾留下的两处边角,防止平台自己的内容被悄悄写进某个包里,变成那个包的东西。
- 出错会怎样:只涉及两个少见的管理操作;被拒绝时什么都不写,本改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

**Item 1 — a version the platform registered is never restored into a package's row.** Reproduced on main first (pins red on base, readings below): after the platform withdraws its record of a skill, the name's one remaining holder is the package, a version attributed to the environment counts as that package's slot (`isVersionOf` / `isAddressedVersion`, M1), and a rollback naming the package, or bare, answered `Reverted to version 1 (package=com.acme.crm)` and wrote the platform's body into the package's row. It reproduced at all three restore doors: the metadata service's `rollback`, and the protocol's `rollbackMetaItem` and restore limb of `revertCommit` (the last for a commit that names its package, as `recordPackageCommit` always writes it; that limb passes no `versionOf`, so it reaches this whenever the commit's version is one the platform registered).

Route taken: **the loud refusal**, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, the envelope of `refusePlatformRecordRestore`, nothing written; `revertCommit` lands the item in `failed[]` and still reverts the commit's other items. Judged on the four axes:
- real business need: the scenario is the one the platform's withdrawal produces for a name a package also ships (the #37013 slot model), measured at three doors, not a speculative surface;
- long-term soundness: one rule in the producer (`@objectstack/metadata`) that all three doors ask, rather than a per-door filter of which versions a package "wrote";
- keeping AI from writing wrong metadata: a refusal that names the fix ("save it again naming the package") beats a silently narrower version list — an author or agent sees why, and nothing is written behind its back;
- no scope growth: no new code, reason value, key or route; `restore only the package's own versions` would have meant re-defining the M1 attribution rule that history reads share, a larger change for the same outcome.

The refusal lives in `refusePlatformRecordRestore` as an optional fourth argument (the version's history row, its number, and the package whose row is written). The version is judged by its history row with the one reader below: attributed to no package or to the environment, and its body carries the platform's mark and names no package. A version restored into the package-less row (the environment's own item) is left as before.

**Item 2 — adopt-orphans leaves the platform's own record.** Reproduced on main: `reassignOrphanedMetadata` rebound the platform's package-less row to the target package. It now skips a row `isPlatformRecordRow` reads as the platform's record, as it skips an artifact-backed overlay; every other orphan is adopted as before.

**N5 — one platform-row reader.** `isPlatformRecordRow(row)` is now exported from `@objectstack/metadata` (`database-loader.ts`): the package column names no package (empty, or the environment's history mark) and the body carries the platform's mark and names no package. `refusePlatformRecordRestore`, the protocol's overlay census (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, whose private copy is deleted — the only edit in that file) and the adoption ask it. Consequence: a package-bound row whose body keeps the mark is no longer refused by the row rule (it was refused, prescribing to name the package already named).

**N1** — the refusal's prescription now says re-saving a version's body as the environment's own item "holds until the platform's next registration at boot writes its record back".

**N2** — new pins ride `rollbackMetaItem` (named and bare) and `revertCommit` with a commit that names its package.

**#37187 N3** — `listPackageBindings` skips, in its row walk, a loader the list walk already lost: named once in `errors`, reported once, its rows not read a second time.

**#37187 N6** — one doc-comment sentence in `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts`: a primed copy answers its row's column as the registry last knew it (the column the boot priming pass wrote when it bound the row, else the column it was read with).

**N3 (#37423 review) — dropped.** `.changeset/37013-platform-skill-own-slot.md` is no longer pending: the prerelease `chore: version packages (next)` (`33a31dc7`) compiled it into `packages/metadata/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` and moved it to `.changeset/pre/`. The same holds for the 37130 note that N1 mentions, so N1 changes the runtime message only. A factual fix to a compiled entry belongs in a docs-only PR, not here. N4 needed nothing.

Serial constraints: `protocol-save.ts` is untouched; `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` carries only the shared reader (an import swap and the deleted private copy); `sys-metadata-repository.ts` carries one call-site change.

Public surface: `isPlatformRecordRow` (new export) and the optional fourth argument of `refusePlatformRecordRestore`. With the two refusals, that is why this declares `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, not the claim's `no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no key, accepted value, code or route changes; level `patch`, BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 marker in `.changeset/37604-platform-record-followups.md`.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.platform-mark-rollback.test.ts`: `rollbackMetaItem` naming the package and bare, and `revertCommit` of a commit naming the package, each asserting `code: RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `status: 409`, the message's "the platform registered", and the rows byte-identical; plus a control that the package's own version still restores.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.adopt-orphans-platform-record.test.ts`: the platform's row stays unbound while the environment orphan beside it is adopted; a control that a package-less row whose body names a package is adopted.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`: the service door's `rollback` named and bare after a real `register(..., { origin: 'platform' })` + `unregister(..., { origin: 'platform' })`; N5 reader and refusal envelope pins; the #37187 N3 pin.

<details><summary>Red on base (main 4e10d4bf)</summary>

- protocol door: 2 failed, `expected { success: true, … } to match object { code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', … }`; received message `Reverted to version 1 (package=com.acme.crm) — type=skill, name=helper [seq=3]`.
- adopt-orphans: 1 failed, `expected 'app.base' to be null`.
- service door: 2 failed, `expected { name: 'data_explorer', … } to match object { code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', … }`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; each mutation landed via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, rebuilt, dist preflight checked, restored to HEAD and rebuilt)</summary>

- version refusal disabled: `database-loader.test.ts` 2 failed / 498 passed; protocol files 3 failed / 9 passed (the two `rollbackMetaItem` pins and the `revertCommit` pin).
- lost-loader skip disabled: the #37187 N3 pin failed (1 / 500).
- reader's column check removed: the two N5 pins failed (2 / 500).
- adopt-orphans filter disabled: the adopt pin failed (1 / 2).
</details>

<details><summary>Suites after the merge of main (33a31dc7)</summary>

- `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck: exit 0 (tree of 478efd8d).
- `@objectstack/metadata` vitest: Test Files 83 passed, Tests 2814 passed (tree of 478efd8d).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` vitest: Test Files 371 passed / 9 skipped, Tests 23446 passed / 45 skipped (478efd8d). The head d96a1a97 adds one module-top import to the new adopt pin (check:test-source-alias asked for it).
- `@objectstack/spec` build + `check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- Local gates (exit 0): check-adr-0087-registration, check-changeset-no-major, check-empty-changeset, check-closing-keyword-parity, check-issue-citations, check:durability-log-level, check:startup-registry-verdict, check:doc-authoring, check:nul-bytes, check:undeclared-dep-imports, check:facade-delegation-only, check:engine-double-contract, check:test-source-alias, check:adr-anchors. NOT MEASURED: check:published-readme-exports (exit 3, workspace not built), check:dev-prereqs (workspace not built). The other derived families run in CI.
- Full dogfood battery on the final head: running at PR open; its reading goes to the dispatch report.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The two `.changeset/pre/` notes (37013, 37130) still carry "of a failed batch row write" and the unqualified re-save prescription in the compiled changelogs; not edited here (see N3 above).
- Other readers of the same fact remain in `database-loader.ts` (the write path's `platformRow` and the platform withdrawal's `taken`); they read `isPlatformOrigin` off the body alone. They were not N5's pair and are left as they are; whether they should ask the shared reader is not measured here.
- `restore only versions the package itself wrote` was the alternative route; not taken, for the reasons above.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` (`isPlatformRecordRow`, `refusePlatformRecordRestore`, the `registerRollback` call), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` (`restoreVersion`'s call), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts` (the orphan filter).

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.platform-mark-rollback.test.ts src/protocol.adopt-orphans-platform-record.test.ts` (after building `@objectstack/metadata`) — expect 12 passed.
